info.title: Sessionboard Public API
info.description: REST API for managing sessions, speakers, contacts, sponsors, exhibitors, and event data on the Sessionboard platform.

tags.name: Agent sign-up
tags.description: Sign up for a self-serve Sessionboard product (Marketing, Learning, Awards, Sessions, CRM) from an AI agent, then save a card and start a plan, with no person in Sessionboard's UI except the card, which they save on Stripe's page. The person proves their email with a 6-digit code Sessionboard sends them; neither Sessionboard nor the agent ever sees a card number.

get.description: What one person did with the organization, for a card inside a CRM: the Engagement score (0 to 100; it counts taking part, not money), where that score sits among the organization's members, counts of talks, reviews, CE hours, award entries, events, webinars and courses, open items and the best next step. Matches the person by their CRM or AMS record id (`ams_id`), then by `email`. A person Sessionboard does not know answers `matched: false` with every count 0, not a 404. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`; refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/crm/member-value`.

parameters.name: ams_id
parameters.description: The person's record id in the CRM or AMS (a Salesforce Contact or Account id, a Dataverse contactid, a HubSpot contact id).

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Used when `ams_id` matches no one. Send `ams_id`, `email` or both.

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: Match `ams_id` only on this app's connection.

403.description: Token lacks `read:crm`, or is restricted to particular events

get.description: What Sessionboard's agents suggest about people: invite to speak, invite to review, a renewal at risk, an award nominee, credits to finish. Each has one sentence of reason built from the person's own activity. Open suggestions by default; an open one past its expiry reads `expired`. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Also at `GET /v1/crm/suggestions`.

parameters.name: ams_id
parameters.description: Only this person's suggestions (their CRM or AMS record id).

403.description: Token lacks `read:crm`, or is restricted to particular events

post.description: Accepts an open suggestion and creates its draft in Sessionboard: a speaker suggestion puts the person in the CRM Pipeline; the others are queued for the program's owner. Nothing is sent to the person. Returns the draft's link. A suggestion that is no longer open answers 400. Requires `write:crm`. Also at `POST /v1/crm/suggestions/{suggestionId}/accept`.

400.description: The suggestion is no longer open

404.description: No such suggestion in this organization

post.description: Closes an open suggestion. A suggestion that is no longer open answers 400. Requires `write:crm`. Also at `POST /v1/crm/suggestions/{suggestionId}/dismiss`.

400.description: The suggestion is no longer open

404.description: No such suggestion in this organization

post.description: Ranks the organization's people for a topic: who spoke on it, who attended its sessions, who is tagged with it. Each person comes with reasons from their own activity and warnings to weigh (a lapsed membership, an early-career member type); warnings never remove anyone. Reads only, so `read:crm` is enough. Also at `POST /v1/crm/agents/speaker-finder`.

403.description: Token lacks `read:crm`, or is restricted to particular events

post.summary: Find speakers and keep them as suggestions
post.description: Runs the speaker finder and keeps each person as an open `speaker` suggestion for the topic. Running it again refreshes the open suggestion instead of adding another. Nothing is sent to anyone. Requires `write:crm`. Also at `POST /v1/crm/agents/speaker-finder/suggest`.

post.summary: Create a draft from a CRM action
post.description: The action buttons in a CRM: `invite-to-speak` puts the person in the CRM Pipeline; `nominate` and `enroll` queue the person for the award program's or course's owner. Each creates a draft in Sessionboard and returns its link; nothing is sent to the person. Requires `write:crm`. Also at `POST /v1/crm/actions/{action}`.

amsId.description: The person's CRM or AMS record id.

already.description: The person already had an open Pipeline entry.

404.description: The person, program or course is not in this organization

get.summary: List self-serve plans, prices and card rules
get.description: Every self-serve product's plans with monthly and yearly prices (USD, before tax), limits, the free trial and the card rules, so an agent can compare without a demo. No token. Built from the same catalog checkout bills from.

agent_signup.description: The steps, the MCP endpoint and tools, and what an agent can and cannot do.

429.description: Too many requests from this address

post.summary: Start a sign-up for a person
post.description: Emails the person a 6-digit code that names the agent and the product and says that sharing the code accepts Sessionboard's Terms. Nothing but the code challenge is created. Ask the person for the code, then call verify. No token. Uses the same rules as the web sign-up: a work email, one account per address, five codes per address an hour. Call the region's own host: an EU sign-up never passes through the US API.

region.description: Where the data is stored. Must match the host (409 `wrong_region` otherwise).

agent_name.description: How the email names you, e.g. "Claude".

403.description: `signups_closed`: self-serve sign-up for this product is not open

409.description: `account_exists` (the person should sign in) or `wrong_region` (with `api_url`, the right host)

post.summary: Finish a sign-up with the person's code
post.description: Creates the workspace exactly as the web sign-up does (14-day trial; CRM starts on Free) and returns an OAuth access token (1 hour) and refresh token (7 days, rotating; refresh at `/oauth/token` with `grant_type=refresh_token` and the returned `client_id`) for that person in that workspace. The token works on this API and the MCP server. Five wrong codes end the sign-up. A code from the web sign-up page is refused. No token.

client_id.description: Your OAuth client id from dynamic client registration, if you have one.

get.description: Whether a card is on file (brand and last 4 only), the plan, interval, trial end, whether a plan is running, and whether sending to people waits for a card. Poll it after giving the person a card link. `read:billing` or any product read scope. Also at `GET /v1/organization/{orgId}/billing`.

post.summary: Get a card link for the person
post.description: A Stripe Checkout page in setup mode the person opens to save a card. Nothing is charged. When they finish, Stripe sends them to a Sessionboard page that says "Card saved" and `card_on_file` turns true. Returns no link when a card is already on file. Requires `write:billing` and the person's Plan and billing permission. Also at `POST /v1/organization/{orgId}/billing/card`.

200.description: The link (or that a card is on file)

403.description: Token lacks `write:billing`, or the person lacks the Plan and billing permission

post.summary: Quote or start a plan on the saved card
post.description: Without `confirm`, returns the quote: plan, price, interval, the card's brand and last 4, and when the first charge happens (when the trial ends, if one is running). Tell the person and call again with `confirm: true` only after they agree; that starts the plan on the saved card. The same `request_id` never starts it twice. A workspace already on a plan gets a Stripe page to switch it. Requires `write:billing`. Also at `POST /v1/organization/{orgId}/billing/plan`.

interval.description: Default month. CRM is yearly only.

403.description: Token lacks `write:billing`, or the person lacks the Plan and billing permission

post.description: Invites up to 20 colleagues to the organization, on any kind of account. Each address gets one email: on a self-serve workspace (Marketing, Learning, Awards, Sessions, CRM) they sign in with that address and a 6-digit code, no password; on a Sessionboard Platform account they get the usual invitation to set a password. Each becomes a pending member with the role given (default Org Admin). An address that is already a member is reported, not invited again. Because every invitee is emailed, a call made by an AI assistant (an OAuth connection or an API token) answers `202` with `status: needs_approval` and a Sessionboard link: nothing is sent until a person approves it there, and it then goes out as them. No card is needed: teammates are the organization's own team. Requires `write:team` or the product's own write scope (`write:marketing`, `write:learning`, `write:awards`, `write:sessions`, `write:crm`) and the person's Manage users permission. Seats on a self-serve plan apply. Also at `POST /v1/organization/{orgId}/team/invite`.

emails.description: Work email addresses. Duplicates are invited once.

role.description: Their role in the organization. Default `admin` (Org Admin).

sign_in.description: `code` on a self-serve workspace, `password` on a Platform account.

202.description: An assistant's call: waiting for a person's OK in Sessionboard. Nothing was sent.

url.description: Where a person approves or declines it.

400.description: No email address in the list, more than 20, or an unknown role

403.description: Token lacks `write:team` or a product write scope, the person lacks Manage users, or the plan has no free seats

423.description: A person paused connected assistants in Sessionboard

ApiKey.name: x-access-token
ApiKey.description: Organization API token. Generate from Organization Settings → API Tokens.

BearerToken.description: OAuth 2.1 access token. Obtained via the OAuth PKCE flow at `/oauth/token`.

matched.description: false when Sessionboard does not know the person.

neverSpoke.description: Only people with no session at any of your events.

notReviewingTrack.description: Leave out people who reviewed a matching session.
